_comment: Which brawlers have a hypercharge. Matched by NAME, case-insensitive.
This file is maintained by hand because no free API exposes hypercharge
availability: the official Supercell API omits it entirely, and the
hypercharge field. Verified against the live endpoint during setup.
When a hypercharge ships, add the brawler's name to `hasHypercharge`.
Unlisted brawlers default to false, which the app handles cleanly: no
hypercharge indicator, and the kit-completion ring ignores the slot.
